summary: Faraday Future filed an 8-K/A correcting clerical errors in an October 14, 2026 8-K disclosing a Transaction Agreement signed October 12, 2026 to divest its robotics business. The seller parties—Faraday Future and Cayman subsidiary Smart Technology Holdings—will contribute robotics assets, IP, contracts and employees into FF Robotics, then exchange all FF Robotics equity with buyer FFR; FF Robotics subsequently merges into FFR Acquisition Sub LLC, surviving as an FFR subsidiary. The parties intend Section 368(a) reorganization treatment. Aggregate consideration terms appear truncated; no advisor, premium, or close date stated. Watch for disclosed purchase price, earnouts, and regulatory clearance timing.
